<section class="qs-home-section qs-philosophy">
  <p class="qs-section-kicker">RESEARCH APPROACH</p>
  <h2>From marine observations to reproducible evidence</h2>
  <p class="qs-section-lead">Connecting ecology, data, and decisions in dynamic marine systems.</p>

  <div class="qs-principles">
    <article><span class="qs-principle-number">01</span><h3>Measure change.</h3><p>Marine populations are dynamic. The indicators and models used to study them should preserve that temporal and spatial structure.</p></article>
    <article><span class="qs-principle-number">02</span><h3>Model uncertainty.</h3><p>Evidence is more useful when uncertainty, alternative mechanisms, and model limitations are explicit rather than hidden.</p></article>
    <article><span class="qs-principle-number">03</span><h3>Inform decisions.</h3><p>Analytical complexity matters when it improves interpretation, reproducibility, and the use of evidence in fisheries management.</p></article>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="qs-home-section">
  <div class="qs-section-heading"><div><p class="qs-section-kicker">CURRENT RESEARCH</p><h2>Questions I am working on now</h2></div><a class="qs-text-link" href="projects/">View all projects →</a></div>
  <div class="qs-feature-grid">
    <article class="qs-feature-card"><p class="qs-card-meta">ANCHOVY · STOCK STATE</p><h3>Multidimensional assessment of the north-central Peruvian anchovy stock</h3><p>Integrating population magnitude, condition, reproduction, demographic structure, spatial distribution, and pressure–state relationships.</p><a href="projects/anchovy-stock-state/">Explore project →</a></article>
    <article class="qs-feature-card"><p class="qs-card-meta">ANCHOVY · SELECTIVITY</p><h3>Selectivity and demographic change in the anchovy fishery</h3><p>Evaluating long-term and seasonal changes in length selectivity, selection range, juvenile incidence, and demographic structure.</p><a href="projects/anchovy-selectivity/">Explore project →</a></article>
    <article class="qs-feature-card"><p class="qs-card-meta">TUNA · FISHERY DYNAMICS</p><h3>Peruvian tuna purse-seine fishery</h3><p>Characterizing catch, effort, fishing modes, species composition, standardized CPUE, and environmental associations.</p><a href="projects/tuna-fishery/">Explore project →</a></article>
  </div>
</section>
